b.text: the doves came back in and said kindly: "Aschenputtel, shall we pick out the vetches for you?"

a.text: “Yes, — the bad into the crop, the good into the pot.”

b.text: "Yes, — the bad ones into the little crop, the good ones into the little pot."

a.text: Peck, peck! peck, peck! it went as quickly as if twelve hands were there.

a.text: And when they were finished, the doves said: “Cinderella, do you want to go to the ball too, and dance.”
